title: tc-menu-morph
description: A button that grows into its menu and shrinks back into itself.

open.description: Whether the menu is open. Changed by the user unless a tc-open-change listener calls preventDefault()

align.description: Where the menu lines up with the trigger

side.description: The side the menu prefers – it flips when there's no room

gap.description: Space between the trigger and the menu, px

duration.description: Length of the morph in ms; default the --tc-duration-base token
